origin: Own exact two-channel latent scientific-signal model. There are no empirical spectra, clinical measurements or pretrained source identities. The CSV is a constructed cumulant oracle generated from the stated model class; all calculations are exact rational measurements. It illustrates when dense source separation and inferred noise depend on a latent-law assumption.
sensor_coordinates: The physical centered channel vectorX is not observed directly. Instrument coordinatesY=H*X have known invertibleH=[[1,0.5],[-0.25,1]]. CSV rows are complete symmetric JOINT CUMULANTS: an ordernrow withjY2arguments is cum(Y1,...,Y1,Y2,...,Y2) with n-jcopiesY1 andjcopiesY2. These are NOT coefficients of a homogeneous polynomial; binomial multiplicities belong only when contracting/re-expanding a polynomial. Orders2and4are fitting information; order6is a HELD-OUT model audit and cannot be discarded. Exact rational strings such as a/b mean that rational, not a measured confidence interval. All source rows are required.
strict_binary_model: Assume X=a1*R1+a2*R2+epsilon. R1,R2 are mutually independent fair signs taking+1or-1 with equal probability, hence each has mean0andvariance1. epsilon is centered Gaussian with an arbitrary unknown symmetric positive-semidefinite2x2covarianceSigma, independent of both signs. a1,a2 are unknown finite linearly independent real2vectors; no isotropic, diagonal or known-noise assumption is allowed. Their first coordinates are nonzero for this instance. No exact sign labels or source ordering are observed.
identification: Recover the COMPLETE strict-model mixing/noise solutions, including all unidentifiable signs and source permutations. Report one canonical representative: first coordinate of EACH column positive; order columns by DESCENDING ratio(second coordinate/first coordinate). Return the number of labelled signed solutions and the number of canonical solutions. Derive why the fourth cumulant eliminates Gaussian noise; factor the full binary quartic tensor rather than one arbitrary kurtosis projection. A local ICA optimizer or a covariance eigenvector is not a global uniqueness proof.
actual_linear_algebra_evidence: Use actual MatrixInverse forH and retain actual MatrixMultiply for both steps of the covariance congruence H^-1*Cov(Y)*H^-T, propagating the actual first product. Transform ALL fourth/sixth tensor components with the complete multilinear/binomial convention and audit inverse transport to every input row. From physical fourth cumulantsT_j=cum(X1 repeated4-j,X2 repeatedj), construct the3x3catalectic M_ij=-T_(i+j)/2, i,j=0..2. Retain actual MatrixSVD of this complete matrix. Recover the direction-annihilating monic quadratic from ALL consistent recurrence rows using actual SolveLinearSystem; retain actual PolynomialRoots for every direction root. Recover both positive quartic amplitude weights from ALL five moment rows using an actual linear system, then select real fourth-root amplitudes with canonical signs. Audit duplicate roots, zero first-coordinate/infinite slopes, missing components and nonpositive amplitude alternatives before claiming completeness.
noise_and_holdout: Retain actual MatrixMultiply for A*A^T and derive Sigma from the physical covariance, checking its full positive spectrum with actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition. Retain actual SymmetricEigenDecomposition of the physical covariance too, and compare its axes with mixing directions without treating eigenvector sign/order as scientific gold. Check all held-out sixth joint cumulants from the recovered strict model. Determine whether any ONE binary component plus arbitrary Gaussian noise could reproduce the fourth tensor. Matching finite moments is not a general proof of a latent distribution outside the stated model class.
demixing: Retain actual MatrixInverse for the recovered canonicalA and actual MatrixMultiply of BOTH steps of A^-1*Sigma*A^-T. Does A^-1*X have independent noisy observed components? Distinguish independent latent signs from additive correlated Gaussian noise. Diagonalizing the observed covariance or whitening it is not automatically the same as demixing physical sources when measurement noise has unknown cross-channel covariance.
relaxed_source_class: Now relax ONLY the source-law assumption. Use the canonical strict-model columnsai as reference directions and amplitudes, and unknown variance multipliers vi>=1. Let Ui=(Ri+sqrt(vi-1)*Gi)/sqrt(vi), where all Ri and standard GaussianGi are independent. Ui are independent, symmetric and unit variance. Replace the signal model by X=sum_i sqrt(vi)*ai*Ui+epsilon_new, with independent centered Gaussian epsilon_new whose covariance must be positive semidefinite. This is a specified mathematical latent-law family, not an arbitrary kurtosis fit. Derive the COMPLETE feasible( v1,v2 )region, including all boundary/degenerate noise cases, rather than inspect a finite grid.
sharp_gaussian_allocation: Use the actual inverse of strict-modelSigma to derive and audit the sharp individual upper bound for EACHvi with the other free to vary; retain actual MatrixInverse ofSigma. Return lower/upper bounds for each multiplier. Then maximize v1+v2 over the FULL coupled feasible region, report its complete maximizing pair (unique here), corresponding full noise covariance and both standardized source excess kurtoses. Give a global PSD/dual inequality or equivalent analytic proof and feasible equality witness, not just a numerical stationary point. Explicitly show why individually attainable upper endpoints cannot necessarily be combined. Audit all physical PSD principal minors, including singular boundaries without forcing strict positive definiteness.
observational_equivalence: Prove or disprove whether the feasible relaxed models reproduce only the supplied low-order moments, or the ENTIRE observed probability law. A claim about all cumulants must be grounded in the characteristic function or an exact independent-Gaussian decomposition, not a few matching orders. Explain whether more moments or unlimited observations of the SAME channels can identify this Gaussian allocation, and distinguish that question from identification under the strict known-binary assumption.

interpretation_proposals.A: Covariance whitening recovers physical independent source axes even with arbitrary unknown correlated Gaussian sensor noise.
interpretation_proposals.B: Higher-order cumulants can identify binary mixing directions despite unknown Gaussian measurement covariance.
interpretation_proposals.C: A nonsingular signed mixing matrix makes the corresponding noisy demixed observations independent regardless of the noise covariance.
interpretation_proposals.D: Known binary source laws remove an amplitude/noise ambiguity that can reappear in a wider independent-source family.
interpretation_proposals.E: A singular residual Gaussian covariance is a valid boundary model if it is positive semidefinite.
interpretation_proposals.F: The two sharp marginal amplitude upper bounds can always be combined into one feasible model.
interpretation_proposals.G: Matching fourth and sixth cumulants proves a latent independent-component model without any distributional assumptions.
interpretation_proposals.H: An exact redistribution of independent Gaussian variance between latent components and residual noise can preserve the whole observed law.

reporting: Use the public JSON schema. Arrays of order4and6cumulants are in increasing number of second-channel arguments, including all zeros if present. Canonical mixing columns ordered by descending slope; a separate slope list is ascending. All covariance arrays use physicalXcoordinates unless the field says demixed. Absolute numeric tolerance1e-7 except exact ranks/counts/booleans/IDsets. Feasible variance multipliers must satisfyvi>=1; PSD and complete positivity constraints are physical requirements, not excuses to admit a negative-variance model within answer tolerance. Source and full tensor/decomposition proofs remain in the trajectory.
